outline.covers: Uchta narsa yetarli ekanini aniq sanaydi: (1) User ID va Server ID, (2) Telegram, (3) O'zbekiston kartasi yoki Click/Payme hisobi. Nima KERAK EMASligini ham ochiq yozadi: parol, Moonton akkaunt, VPN, Visa/Mastercard, xorijiy valyuta hisobi. Akkauntga kirish talab qilinmasligini ta'kidlaydi.

Botni ochish → Mobile Legends ni tanlash → User ID kiritish → Server ID kiritish → nickname ekranda chiqishi va uni tasdiqlash → paket tanlash → to'lov usulini tanlash → so'mda to'lash → olmos ~1 daqiqada tushishi. Har qadamda foydalanuvchi ekranda nimani ko'rishini tasvirlaydi. HowTo schema aynan shu bo'limdan olinadi.

outline.h2: User ID va Server ID ni qayerdan olasiz
outline.covers: Qisqa versiya: lobbi → chapdagi avatar → profil oynasi pastida 123456789 (1234) formati; birinchi raqam User ID, qavs ichidagisi Server ID. Recharge oynasi orqali muqobil yo'l. Bu yerda faqat qisqa javob beriladi va to'liq qo'llanmaga (mobile-legends-user-id-server-id-qayerda) havola qilinadi — takrorlanish bo'lmasin.

outline.h2: To'lov usullari: Click, Payme, UzCard, HUMO, Paynet
outline.covers: Jadval: to'lov usuli | qanday ishlaydi | kimga qulay | odatiy tasdiqlash vaqti. Barchasi so'mda, konvertatsiya yo'q, xorijiy karta shart emas. Karta 3D-Secure/SMS tasdiqlashi haqida qisqa izoh. Hech qanday so'mdagi narx yozilmaydi.

outline.h2: Narx qanday shakllanadi va nega o'zgaradi
outline.covers: Narx provayder tarifi va USDT kursiga bog'liqligini, shuning uchun kun davomida siljishi mumkinligini tushuntiradi. Katta paketlarda bir olmosning tannarxi odatda pasayishi. Saytda qat'iy raqam yozilmasligi sababi va "joriy narx botda paket tanlaganda ko'rsatiladi" formulasi. Aniq so'm raqami yo'q.

outline.h2: Nickname tekshiruvi — to'lovdan oldin va bepul
outline.covers: ID kiritilgach nickname avtomatik chiqishi, bu tekshiruv bepul va to'lovsiz ekani; nickname mos kelmasa TO'LAMASLIK kerakligi. Do'stga sovg'a qilishda ham aynan shu tekshiruv himoya vazifasini bajarishi.

Server ID ni tushirib qoldirish; qavs ichidagi raqamni User ID ga qo'shib yozish; ID ni bo'sh joy yoki qavs belgilari bilan nusxalash; nickname'ni ID o'rniga yozish; Global emas, boshqa region akkaunti; to'lov paytida ilovadan chiqib ketish. Har biriga bir qatorli yechim. Muammo maqolasiga havola.
@Gempayuz_bot ga havola, /oyinlar/mobile-legends sahifasiga havola, @StarsPaymeeSupport qo'llab-quvvatlash. Qisqa ishonch qatori: ID orqali ishlaydi, parol so'ralmaydi, ~1 daqiqa.

cannibalisationFixes.problem: Unbranded "olmos sotib olish", "olmos to'ldirish", "olmos kelmadi", "olmos nima" are real Uzbek queries, and four pillars plus four problem articles compete for them with no designated owner. Worse, one of the four is a live-streaming app, so the same head term maps to two different buyer intents.
cannibalisationFixes.fix: Designate MLBB the unbranded-"olmos" owner (highest UZ demand): it may lead with the bare term. The other three must place the brand token before "olmos" in H1, metaTitle and the first five words of the answerBox, and drop unbranded variants from their keyword sets. Route the unbranded head through the cross-game hub oyin-valyutasi-qayerdan-arzon, which links down to all four.

cannibalisationFixes.problem: All nine clusters repeat a near-identical price-logic block (USDT kursi → narx botda ko'rsatiladi), a near-identical "parol hech qachon so'ralmaydi" safety block, and a near-identical "bepul generator = firibgarlik" block. That is 27+ near-duplicate sections across 45 URLs, and — critically — no single page can rank for the unbranded queries those sections answer: "donat narxi nega o'zgaradi", "o'yinga pul quyish xavfsizmi", "bepul olmos generatori ishlaydimi", "eng arzon donat qayerda".
cannibalisationFixes.fix: Build the three cross-game hubs the plans already link to fourteen times but never planned: oyin-valyutasi-qayerdan-arzon (price mechanics + how to compare), oyin-pul-xavfsiz-toldirish (ID vs password, scam patterns, account recovery), gempay-ishonli-xizmat (who we are, refunds, order IDs, support SLA). Ship them in Wave 1, cut each in-article block to 2-3 sentences plus a link, and let the hubs own the unbranded terms and absorb the duplication.

Five pillars nominally target overlapping RU queries that none of them can win, so the plan double-counts traffic that does not exist.
